# API scan report schema
metadata:
  udi: prismata.astalyzer.schema.api-scan-report
  name: api-scan-report
  version: 0.1.0
  kind: schema-definition
  description: Structured report for recursive API scanning.

id: "prismata.astalyzer.schema.api-scan-report"
version: 0.1.0
kind: schema-definition
description: >
  Structured report for recursive API scanning.

type: object

fields:
  root_path:
    type: string
    required: true

  files_scanned:
    type: array
    items:
      type: string
    required: true

  external_apis:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      fields:
        module:
          type: string
        symbol:
          type: string
        import_type:
          type: string
        location:
          type: string
    required: false

  functions:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      fields:
        name:
          type: string
        inputs:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        outputs:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
        location:
          type: string
    required: false

_tags:
  category: code_analysis
  tags:
    - api
    - scanner
    - recursive
    - pcms2026
